dpdp_compliance_notice: Personal data and interaction telemetry collected during this assessment are processed solely to evaluate volunteer alignment with Alfaaz Collective creative initiatives. All data is stored under pseudonymous session identifiers, safeguarded against unauthorized access, and never used for automated rejection, ranking algorithms, or commercial profiling.
retention_policy: Recruitment and assessment telemetry data are retained indefinitely as part of the permanent research calibration record. There is no automated or manual deletion path for completed volunteer sessions.
